title: [regression] typedRoutes: breaks when `webpackBuildWorker: true`, and both Node.js routes and Edge routes are present

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression

### To Reproduce

Clone the repository and run `next build`.

### Current vs. Expected behavior

It compiles in Next.js 14.0.1 or below, but does not compile in 14.0.2 and above with the following error:

https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/actions/runs/6847595704/job/18616146686
```
./app/page.tsx:6:13
Type error: "/" is not an existing route. If it is intentional, please type it explicitly with `as Route`.

  4 |   return (
  5 |     <main className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-between p-24">
> 6 |       <Link href="/">
    |             ^
  7 |         Hello, world!
  8 |       </Link>
  9 |     </main>
```

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: linux
  Arch: x64
  Version: #3570-Microsoft Fri Sep 29 17:00:00 PST 2023
Binaries:
  Node: 20.8.0
  npm: 10.1.0
  Yarn: 1.22.19
  pnpm: N/A
Relevant Packages:
  next: 14.0.2
  eslint-config-next: 14.0.2
  react: 18.2.0
  react-dom: 18.2.0
  typescript: 5.2.2
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link), TypeScript (plugin, built-in types)

### Additional context

I can confirm that it still fails in `14.0.3-canary.5`: https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/actions/runs/6847704451/job/18616468851

Also, it compiles without problem if I do one of the following:
- remove the line `webpackBuildWorker: true` in [`next.config.js`](https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/blob/main/next.config.js)
  - https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/pull/3
- remove the line `export const runtime = 'edge'` in [`app/api/hello/route.ts`](https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/blob/main/app/api/hello/route.ts#L4)
  - https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/pull/2
- downgrade Next.js to 14.0.1
  - https://github.com/cannorin/next-14.0.2-typedroutes-regression/pull/1
